issues.problem: specified_initial_versions was treated as per-source overrides instead of complete initial source membership, so newly added P83 existed before add.
Declared operation sync was unsupported; cold setup blocked and warm attempt did not reattempt blocked setup.
Destination copy rejected its own new directory; workspace/state metadata lacked UI-required timestamps.

Declared add_file .DS_Store was unsupported in cold setup and skipped on warm. Corrected adapter writes exactly the declared original bytes through ProjectFilesystem; production decides whether to ingest.

Obsolete adapter status guard interpreted any local_user principal as unavailable enterprise ACL. Removed false blocked classification. Full access/side-effect audits remain unmeasured; this change is not a permission pass.
Source setup now runs once for a newly created session regardless of requested cold/warm label, and cannot silently skip a previously failed setup.

policy: Preserve original baseline. Replay separately. These are harness/setup defects, not product failures or product improvements.
